## Files changed
New crate `crates/hh-secrets` (deps wire/identity/provenance/ontology/hir/
ledger/monitor/containment only — no `Text` leaf authored, no model call on any
path):
- `types.rs` — `SecretRef{channel_id, description}`, `ProvidedSecret{provided}`
  (the only value fact — `yes/no`), `SecretFingerprint` (keyed, truncated,
  irreversible), `Placeholder` (`mh_secret:v1:<channel>:r<rev>:<nonce>` — nonce
  = `idp/1`-framed digest over `run_id ∥ binding_id`, SV-10 non-transferable),
  `BindingState`, `KernelPurpose`, `AccessClass`, `SecretUnavailable`.
- `channel.rs` — the §5g.3 §3 sums verbatim: `CredentialKind`,
  `SecretSource{operator_vault|os_keyring|launch_env|external_binding}`,
  `DestinationBinding{scheme, host_pattern, port?, path_prefix?, auth_carrier}`,
  `AuthCarrier{header{name,prefix?}|basic|query_forbidden}`,
  `SenderConstraint{dpop|audience|none}`, `SecretChannelSpec` (`destinations`,
  `delivery_modes_allowed`, `max_lifetime`, `sender_constraint`, `canary`,
  `bindable`, `access_class`, `allowed_env_names`, `constraints`,
  `rotation_policy`), `SecretChannel{channel_id, spec, revision, provenance}`
  with `idp/1` `version_id` over the canonical form (CC1); strict codecs.
- `broker.rs` — the kernel-side `CredentialBroker`: `register_channel`,
  `grant` (scope ⊆ channel destinations; issuer ≥ `principal`), `bind`
  (PDP gate → mode → isolation → `bound` durable-before-visible), `mediate`
  (normative refusal order; staged `Delivery` + durable `used` before return),
  `mint` (`Deferred{stage: 2}` — failure-typed SPI), `revoke` (idempotent),
  `on_run_terminal` (SV-6 implicit revoke), `rotate` (CAS `Conflict{current}`;
  old value retained in the mask set *before* the swap — fails closed;
  rotated+revoked in one durable batch), `kernel_use` (`bindable=false`/
  `kernel_only` path; `used{destination = kernel:<purpose>}`), `fingerprint`,
  `mask_set` (fails closed — SV-1 completeness), `leak_scan_run`,
  `env_spec_for`, `terminal_secret_unavailable`; resolver SPI
  (`SecretSourceResolver`/`StaticVault`/`LaunchEnvResolver`/`CompositeResolver`/
  `DenyAllResolver`); `path_is_ambiguous` (LT-02's Stage-1 shape).
- `decisions.rs` — `DecisionView` fold over `security.permission.{granted,
  decided,revoked}`; `covering_secret_access` (decided{allow} + live handle +
  holder + `secret_access` scope coverage).
- `env.rs` — `EnvSpec{allowlist, bindings}`/`EnvBinding`/`ProjectedEnv`,
  `env_apply`/`env_snapshot`/`env_sweep`/`is_inheritable`,
  `KERNEL_NONINHERITABLE` + the credential-shaped suffix rules (withheld even
  when allow-listed).
- `redact.rs` — `DetectorKind{known_value, pattern, canary,
  placeholder_passthrough}`, `DetectorSet`, `Hit`, `RedactionTombstone`
  (`REDACTED[<detector>:<fingerprint|label>]` — content-free), `Leak`,
  `ScanTarget{event|blob|request_view|definition|sink_delivery|mediation}`,
  `detect`/`redact`/`leak_scan` (a test verifier — never a live interceptor).
- `mask.rs` — `MaskSet`/`MaskEntry` (longest-first; live + rotated coverage).
- `patterns.rs` — the registered deterministic token-shape detectors (Google /
  AWS / GitHub / OpenAI / PEM / Slack); encoded variants are C1 (DF-S1.13-4).
- `metrics.rs` — the four `secret_*` veto `MetricDeclaration`s
  (`secret_value_in_{ledger,model_context,environment,report}` — `veto: true`,
  `requires_mediation: broker`, deterministic detectors only).
- `defscan.rs` — `scan_document`/`seal_checked`/`check_diff` (the
  `SecretValueInDefinition` gates — AC-R-2.8.3-8).
- `events.rs`/`codec.rs`/`errors.rs` — the content-free `security.credential.*`/
  `security.secret.*` payload builders; the strict codec helpers; the closed
  `RefusedCode`/`BrokerError` sums (`Conflict{current}` included).
- `tests/acceptance.rs` + `tests/sv.rs` — the AC + SV batteries.

Additive edits:
- `hh-ledger` — the seven `security.credential.{bound,used,denied,revoked,
  rotated}` + `security.secret.{redacted,leak_detected}` class rows (durable,
  events-observable, audit-grade, kernel-origin, provenance-mandatory).
- `hh-identity` — `RecordKind::SecretChannel` + `RecordKind::CredentialBinding`.
- `hh-hir` — `HirError::SecretValueInDefinition`; `HirDocument::text_leaves()`
  recursive `Text` enumeration (nodes + edges); `HirDiff::to_json()`/
  `canonical_bytes()`.
- `hh-assembly` — the `SecretValueInDefinition` diagnostic mirror.
- `hh-monitor` — `SecretTransport::{as_str, parse}` + `Ord`/`Hash` (the
  `delivery_modes_allowed` vocabulary — CC7, no second enum).
- `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock` — workspace member wiring.

## Acceptance criteria
Executable at Stage 1 (ticket header): **AC-R-2.8.3-{1,8,10,13}**.
- AC-1 (LT-01): env dump + proc-env read + snapshot carry placeholders only;
  `leak_scan(run) = ∅`; `SecretRef` renders `channel_id (description)`.
- AC-8 (LT-08, static): literal credential in a definition fails `seal` with
  `SecretValueInDefinition`; a `HirDiff` introducing one is rejected.
- AC-10 (LT-10): broker/vault/ledger-writer unavailability fails closed —
  `Refused{broker_unavailable}`/`{audit_unavailable}` (+ durable `denied` where
  the writer lives), never an env-value fallback; the model boundary receives
  `SecretUnavailable{channel, reason}`.
- AC-13 (PDP/CDP): `bind`/`mediate` without a covering `decided{allow}` is
  `DecisionMissing`; a `decided{deny}` does not cover; a revoked handle
  uncovers at delivery; the monitor's recorded inputs contain no value.
- Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; every new behaviour has a test
  that fails if removed; R-2.8.3 stamped in the PR; DEFERRALS rows for the
  Stage-2+ remainders; ADR-0244; BUILD_INDEX row; LEDGER advanced.

- **AC-R-2.8.3-1 (LT-01):** `ac_r_2_8_3_1_environment_and_views_show_
  placeholders_only` — the projected env carries `PATH`/`HOME` verbatim +
  `GH_API_TOKEN = mh_secret:v1:github:r1:<nonce>`; `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` and
  a non-allow-listed name are absent; dump/proc-env/snapshot contain no value;
  `leak_scan` over the surfaces and the run's committed payloads is ∅;
  `env_sweep` clean; `SecretRef::render() = "github (GitHub API token)"`.
- **AC-R-2.8.3-8 (LT-08):** `ac_r_2_8_3_8_literal_credential_fails_seal_and_
  diff` — a `Text` leaf carrying `sk-live-…` fails `seal_checked` with
  `SecretValueInDefinition`; `$secret:github` (the legal reference form)
  scans clean; a `HirDiff` whose op introduces the literal is rejected by
  `check_diff`.
- **AC-R-2.8.3-10 (LT-10):** `ac_r_2_8_3_10_fail_closed_no_env_fallback` —
  `DenyAllResolver` ⇒ `mediate` is `Refused{broker_unavailable}` with a durable
  `denied` row; `mask_set()` fails closed the same way; a fenced writer lease
  turns `bind` into `AuditUnavailable` with no binding created;
  `SecretUnavailable{channel: "github", reason: broker_unavailable}` is the
  terminal observation.
- **AC-R-2.8.3-13 (PDP/CDP):** `ac_r_2_8_3_13_pdp_decides_broker_delivers` —
  no `decided` row ⇒ `bind` is `DecisionMissing`; `decided{deny}` does not
  cover; `decided{allow}` + a covering `secret_access` handle binds; revoking
  the handle uncovers `mediate` at delivery (`DecisionMissing` again); every
  `security.permission.*` payload is verified value-free.
- **Universal phase-gate AC:** workspace green; 18 new tests each naming the
  AC/SV they pin; R-2.8.3 stamped in the PR body; DF-S1.13-1…4 opened;

## Deviations / notes
- **Stage-map placement of `mediate`/`rotate`/`grant`/`kernel_use`** — §5g.3 §9
  lists `mediate`/`rotate` under C0/Stage 2, but AC-R-2.8.3-13 is a Stage-1
  gating criterion exercised *through* `mediate`, and `rotate`'s CAS+retention
  is pure kernel-side machinery. The verbs land now with the staged-`Delivery`
  cut (the wire rewrite is still S2.4's) — additive, not a re-decision.
  Recorded in ADR-0244 §3/§6 + Consequences.
- **Tooling note (this run)** — the file-view/edit tools and the shell's disk
  view diverged mid-run (writes landed in an overlay that the compiler did not
  see); diagnosis + reconciliation via shell-side atomic patches; final state
  verified by `cargo` on disk. No content loss; the committed tree is the
  compiled one.
